v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
text.en: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

text.la: Quam magnificáta * sunt ópera tua, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, * how great are thy works!

text.la: Lætábitur iustus * in Dómino et sperábit in eo.
text.en: The just shall rejoice * in the Lord, and shall hope in him.

text.la: Osténde nobis, Dómine, * lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: Show us, O Lord, * the light of thy mercies.
Let every thing that hath breath * praise the Lord.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Raymúndum pœniténtiæ sacraménti insígnem minístrum elegísti, et per maris undas mirabíliter traduxísti: concéde; ut eius intercessióne dignos pœniténtiæ fructus fácere, et ad ætérnæ salútis portum perveníre valeámus.
text.en: O God, Who didst choose the blessed Raymond to be an eminent minister of the Sacrament of Penance, and in a wonderful manner didst make him to pass over the waves of the sea, grant unto us, at his petition, the grace to bring forth fruits worthy of repentance, and in the end to attain unto the harbour of eternal salvation.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Indulgéntiam nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáta Emerentiána Virgo et Martyr implóret: quæ tibi grata semper éxstitit, et mérito castitátis, et tuæ professióne virtútis.
text.en: O Lord, we pray thee, that thy blessed handmaiden and witness Emerentiana in whom Thou hast ever been well pleased, because of her worthy maidenhood and her mighty showing-forth of thy power, may entreat thy pardon on our behalf.
